summary.text: Lakesia Collins, a Democrat, has represented Illinois's 5th Senate District since 2023, after serving in the Illinois House from 2020 to 2023, according to the General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Her General Assembly biography describes her as a Chicago native and a mother of three.
It says she worked as a certified nursing assistant in nursing homes and as a labor organizer and spokesperson for the Fight for 15 campaign.
